text:
alex: Quick heads-up: after the AWQ+INT8 rollout for mistral-7b-l, our perf tests show a weird latency tail when RoPE scaling is enabled. KV cache eviction spikes on long convo traces.

maria: ugh, numbers?

alex: baseline qwen14b fp16: p50 28ms p99 140ms. mistral-7b-awq-int8 with rope_scale=1.04: p50 32ms p99 420ms. CPU spikes on kernel fallback traces. logs/snippet: ```2026-03-15 09:12:21 kernel=matmul_awq fallback=gemm_slow reason=overflow_detected``` 

sam: interesting. do we see more KV churn or larger batches?

alex: KV churn. hotset size doubles with long seqs >1024. microbatching helps but increases overall tokens/sec drop.

rachel: any accuracy delta from AWQ calibration?

alex: small: calib prompts (5-shot math + code) show +0.6% EM drop vs fp16 on a few eval sets. GPTQ baseline was +0.2% so AWQ worse here.

maria: could be quantization interacting with RoPE head dim mismatch. which kernel chosen?

alex: kernel selector picks awq_matmul_v1 for most heads, but for tail it falls back to gemm_kern_v2 (scalar path). suspect misaligned head dims after head-splitting for mixtral-like configs.

sam: what's head_kv config for this model? any odd sizes?

alex: heads=32, kv_dim=128, head_dim=4? looks like head_dim not divisible by 8 for some layers after LoRA fusing; triggers scalar path in AWQ.

dylan: repro plan: 1) force kernel_selector_pref=awq_no_fallback 2) run with rope_scale=1.0 and 1.04 3) profile KV eviction with /debug/kv-hotset

maria: also try batch_window_ms from 5 -> 15, and enable prefix_cache=off for a run.

rachel: Triage notes: if fallback is the culprit we can: a) patch AWQ kernel to handle non-multiples (slow path vectorized) b) adjust head-slicing at compile time c) add an adaptive batching heuristic that reduces batch size on fallback spikes

alex: quick patch idea: in kernel selector, prefer fp8_matmul for layers where head_dim % 8 != 0 and rope_scale != 1.0. fp8 path seems more tolerant in profiling.

sam: caveat: fp8 had +0.4% accuracy delta. need to include eval gating.

alex: agreed. running A/B with eval harness now: will check EM and perplexity on calib prompts.

ci-bot: perf job queued: run/eng-runtime/awq-ropescale.weekly #id=48721

maria: ok, if the perf job reproduces we should do a canary rollback for AWQ on mistral-7b and open a regression ticket.

dylan: creating ticket: REG-3187 with stack trace and kernel-selection logs. attaching flamegraphs.

rachel: also add a 'kv-hotset' metric to console dashboard (per-model) so we can alert when hotset grows 2x baseline.

alex: thanks. short term mitigations listed in ticket. will post results here when job finishes. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all. ping me if you need infra to pin a dedicated pool for testing.

alex: will do.
